title: Peritoneal dialysis at home
what: A special solution is run in through a tube in your belly. It takes extra waste from your blood, and then it is drained. You do this yourself at home.
why: For severe kidney failure, when it is more convenient to be treated at home than to travel to a unit.
duration: one solution exchange usually takes 30 to 40 minutes, several times a day; or at night with a machine while you sleep
tell_doctor: If the drained fluid becomes cloudy
If your weight, swelling or shortness of breath has changed

prepare.title: Training
prepare.text: Before you start, you and your close ones are trained at the clinic. Do it as you were taught.

prepare.title: Cleanliness
prepare.text: A separate clean place, closed windows, no pets nearby during an exchange.

prepare.title: Hands
prepare.text: Before each exchange, wash your hands thoroughly and put on a mask.

prepare.title: Supplies
prepare.text: Store the solutions as the clinic tells you and watch the expiry date.

bring: Notes of weight, blood pressure and drained volumes - for your visit
steps: You wash your hands, put on a mask and prepare the place
You connect the warmed bag of solution to the tube
First you drain the old solution from the belly
Then you fill in the new one
You disconnect the system and close the tube with a cap
You write down the volume and what the drained fluid looks like
feel: A feeling of fullness in the belly while the solution is inside
Cold solution is unpleasant - it must be warmed
after: Every day check and clean the skin around the tube
Watch your weight, blood pressure and swelling
Follow the diet your doctor prescribed
Come regularly for check-ups at the clinic
red_flags: Cloudy fluid when draining - call the clinic right away
Pus or redness around the tube
Severe shortness of breath or chest pain - call your local emergency number

faq.a: Many people do. Exchanges can be fitted to your schedule, or done by a machine at night.

faq.q: Why is cloudy fluid so important?
faq.a: It is a common sign of inflammation in the belly. You need to call the clinic right away.

reminders.text: Check tomorrow's supply of solution, and write down today's weight and drained volumes.
